summary: A small rounded badge holding a short text or a live count.

text.doc: Fixed text ("New", "999+"); give text or count

count.doc: A live number instead of text: a number or a "@variable", up to 4 digits

pitfalls: textFromFloat `whole` is the number of integer digits kept: whole 1 prints 12 as 2. Use enough digits with flags 5 (no padding before or after)
A badge over an icon is a box holding the icon and the Badge, aligned top-end; the badge is 20 dp tall and wraps its text
